machine_catalogue_entries_published_chec.name: machine_catalogue_entries_published_check
machine_catalogue_entries_published_chec.value: "machine_catalogue_entries"."status" = 'draft' or ("machine_catalogue_entries"."published_at" is not null and "machine_catalogue_entries"."indicative_price_keur" is not null and "machine_catalogue_entries"."lead_time_weeks" is not null)

projects_besoin_ref_check.name: projects_besoin_ref_check
projects_besoin_ref_check.value: "projects"."besoin_ref" is null or ("projects"."capex_code" is not null and "projects"."besoin_ref" ~ '^CPX-[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2,}/B[0-9]{2,}$' and starts_with("projects"."besoin_ref", "projects"."capex_code" || '/'))

need_answers_priced_check.name: need_answers_priced_check
need_answers_priced_check.value: ("need_answers"."nature" = 'qualification' and "need_answers"."central_keur" is null and "need_answers"."estimate_class" is null) or ("need_answers"."nature" <> 'qualification' and "need_answers"."central_keur" is not null and "need_answers"."estimate_class" is not null and "need_answers"."low_keur" is not null and "need_answers"."high_keur" is not null)

shipment_items_kind_check.name: shipment_items_kind_check
shipment_items_kind_check.value: ("shipment_items"."part_id" is not null) or ("shipment_items"."description" is not null)
